feat(keyboard): add group support for append_client_keybindings

Primarily to align with the append_global_keybindings behavior. This feature is indeed useful, as it reduces some boilerplate code.

fix(naughty): timeout=0 doesn't stop existing timer

`set_timeout()` only stopped the old timer inside the `if timeout > 0` branch. When `timeout=0` (meaning "never expire"), the stop never executed, so setting `n.timeout = 0` after creation left the old timer running and eventually destroyed the notification.  Move the timer-stop before the branch so it runs unconditionally, and add an `else` branch that nils out `self.timer` for `timeout=0`.  Fixe

feat(hotkeys_popup): add override_label_bgs option for consistent lab…

…el colors  Add beautiful.hotkeys_override_label_bgs option that, when set to true, applies hotkeys_label_bg to all group labels instead of cycling through xresources colors. This provides users with full control over label background colors for a more consistent appearance.  Fixes #3773

refactor: use variable-length arrays instead of p_alloca

Removing p_alloca is primarily for readability and maintainability. Since p_alloca also performs an extra memset to zero the allocated memory, this change will also yield performance improvements. Since variable-length arrays are already used in the scan function of the awesome.c file, my modification will not cause compatibility issues.

refactor(awesome): use arrays instead of pointer

This saves one strlen call. Since sizeof returns the length including the terminator, I didn't add one.

chore: optimize luaA_class_add_properties

We definitely won't modify the incoming properties, so I added the `const` modifier. As for `count`, since the convention is to use `int`, I changed it.

chore: remove unnecessary array initialization

Structure initialization sets uninitialized fields to zero, just like global variables, so these `array_init` calls are unnecessary. Reference: https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl/pull/9348

fix(naughty): add missing break in cleanup() active list removal

Add `break` after `table.remove` in `cleanup()`'s active-list removal loop. Without it, `ipairs` skips the next entry after removal so destroying multiple notifications in quick succession can leave stale entries in `naughty.active`.  Present since commit 97417121. feat: add luaA_class_add_properties

Adding properties together is faster because the required memory can be allocated all at once.

chore: remove unnecessary p_clear

global variables are initialized to zero by default. We don't need to use memset again.
